```{r}
# =====================================================================
# Figure 1. Mortality Risk Factors by Dibao Status, China, 2011–2020
# Revised independent Cox forest plot: 13 factors, including Hukou.
# Output: 18 cm wide PDF and 300-dpi PNG; no Source/Note in the image.
# =====================================================================

# Install once if needed:
# install.packages(c("readxl", "ggplot2"))

library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)

# 1. Data folder -------------------------------------------------------
data_dir <- "/Users/apple/Desktop/Bag/rolling/Postgraduate/ADV/Week 4/data"
folders <- c(data_dir, file.path(data_dir, "A_Cox_outputs"))
folders <- folders[dir.exists(folders)]
if (length(folders) == 0) stop("Data folder does not exist: ", data_dir)

# Match filenames without their parenthesized version numbers.
# If more than one version exists, use the highest version number.
find_excel <- function(stem) {
  files <- unlist(lapply(folders, function(folder) {
    list.files(folder, pattern = "\\.xlsx$", full.names = TRUE,
               ignore.case = TRUE)
  }), use.names = FALSE)
  files <- unique(files[!grepl("^~\\$", basename(files))])

  names_no_ext <- sub("\\.xlsx$", "", basename(files), ignore.case = TRUE)
  names_clean <- trimws(gsub("[[:space:]]*[(（][^()（）]*[)）]$", "", names_no_ext))
  candidates <- files[tolower(names_clean) == tolower(stem)]
  if (length(candidates) == 0) stop("Excel file not found: ", stem)

  # If a workbook was renamed without (1), (2), etc., prefer it.
  plain <- candidates[tolower(basename(candidates)) ==
                      tolower(paste0(stem, ".xlsx"))]
  if (length(plain) == 1) {
    chosen <- normalizePath(plain, mustWork = TRUE)
    message("Using ", stem, ": ", basename(chosen))
    return(chosen)
  }

  versions <- sub(".*[(（]([0-9]+)[)）]\\.xlsx$", "\\1",
                  basename(candidates), ignore.case = TRUE)
  versions <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(versions))
  versions[is.na(versions)] <- 0L
  selection <- order(versions, file.info(candidates)$mtime,
                     decreasing = TRUE)[1]
  chosen <- normalizePath(candidates[selection], mustWork = TRUE)
  message("Using ", stem, ": ", basename(chosen))
  chosen
}

ever_file  <- find_excel("A_Ever Dibao_Hukou")
never_file <- find_excel("A_Never_Dibao_Hukou")

# 2. Read exactly the 13 regression comparisons ------------------------
read_cox <- function(file, group_name) {
  if (!("Main_Cox_Readable" %in% excel_sheets(file))) {
    stop("Missing Main_Cox_Readable worksheet: ", basename(file))
  }
  raw <- as.data.frame(read_excel(
    file, sheet = "Main_Cox_Readable", range = "A1:I14"
  ))
  needed <- c("comparison", "HR", "lower_95", "upper_95", "p_value")
  if (!all(needed %in% names(raw))) {
    stop("Missing columns in ", basename(file), ": ",
         paste(setdiff(needed, names(raw)), collapse = ", "))
  }
  dat <- raw[, needed, drop = FALSE]
  dat$comparison <- trimws(as.character(dat$comparison))
  if (nrow(dat) != 13 || anyNA(dat$comparison) ||
      anyDuplicated(dat$comparison) > 0) {
    stop("Expected 13 unique comparisons in ", basename(file))
  }
  for (col in c("HR", "lower_95", "upper_95", "p_value")) {
    dat[[col]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(dat[[col]]))
  }
  values <- as.matrix(dat[, c("HR", "lower_95", "upper_95", "p_value")])
  if (any(!is.finite(values)) || any(dat$lower_95 <= 0) ||
      any(dat$lower_95 > dat$HR) || any(dat$HR > dat$upper_95) ||
      any(dat$p_value < 0 | dat$p_value > 1)) {
    stop("Invalid HR, confidence interval or p-value in ", basename(file))
  }
  dat$group <- group_name
  dat
}

never <- read_cox(never_file, "Never Dibao")
ever  <- read_cox(ever_file, "Ever Dibao")

# 3. Label groups, with reference categories ---------------------------
groups <- list(
  list(title = "SEX (ref: Male)",
       names = "Female vs Male", labels = "Female"),
  list(title = "INCOME (ref: T1)",
       names = c("Income T2 vs T1", "Income T3 vs T1"),
       labels = c("T2", "T3")),
  list(title = "MARITAL STATUS (ref: Partnered)",
       names = c("Widowed vs Partnered",
                 "Separated/Divorced vs Partnered",
                 "Never married vs Partnered"),
       labels = c("Widowed", "Separated/Divorced", "Never married")),
  list(title = "LIVING CHILDREN (ref: 0)",
       names = c("1 living child vs 0", "2 living children vs 0",
                 "3+ living children vs 0", "Living children Unknown vs 0"),
       labels = c("1 child", "2 children", "3+ children", "Unknown")),
  list(title = "CHILD CORESIDENCE (ref: No)",
       names = c("Coresident child Yes vs No",
                 "Coresident child Unknown vs No"),
       labels = c("Yes", "Unknown")),
  list(title = "HUKOU (ref: Non-agricultural)",
       names = "Agricultural Hukou vs Non-agricultural Hukou",
       labels = "Agricultural")
)

rows <- data.frame(type = character(), label = character(),
                   comparison = character(), position = numeric(),
                   stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
position <- 0
for (i in seq_along(groups)) {
  g <- groups[[i]]
  if (i > 1) position <- position + 0.55   # gap between categories
  position <- position + 1.05
  rows <- rbind(rows, data.frame(type = "heading", label = g$title,
                                 comparison = NA_character_, position = position))
  for (j in seq_along(g$names)) {
    position <- position + 1.00
    rows <- rbind(rows, data.frame(type = "factor", label = g$labels[j],
                                   comparison = g$names[j], position = position))
  }
}
rows$y <- max(rows$position) - rows$position + 1
headings <- rows[rows$type == "heading", , drop = FALSE]
factors  <- rows[rows$type == "factor", , drop = FALSE]

# Stop rather than silently omit or mix any regression comparison.
expected <- factors$comparison
if (!setequal(never$comparison, expected) ||
    !setequal(ever$comparison, expected)) {
  stop("Factor names in the two Excel files do not match the figure labels.")
}

results <- rbind(never, ever)
results$y <- factors$y[match(results$comparison, factors$comparison)]
if (anyNA(results$y)) stop("A Cox estimate could not be aligned.")
results$y_draw <- results$y +
  ifelse(results$group == "Never Dibao", 0.20, -0.20)

# 4. Axis layout and actual typography ---------------------------------
font_family <- "Times New Roman"
pt_to_mm <- function(pt) pt * 25.4 / 72
body_pt <- 12
heading_pt <- 13.5

hr_min <- 0.2
hr_max <- 5
if (any(results$lower_95 < hr_min | results$upper_95 > hr_max)) {
  stop("At least one CI is outside [0.2, 5]; update axis limits.")
}

# Plotting coordinates: logarithmic HR positions within the right panel.
label_right <- 0.515
axis_left   <- 0.550
axis_right  <- 0.975
x_hr <- function(hr) {
  axis_left + (log(hr) - log(hr_min)) /
    (log(hr_max) - log(hr_min)) * (axis_right - axis_left)
}

results$x    <- x_hr(results$HR)
results$xlow <- x_hr(results$lower_95)
results$xhigh <- x_hr(results$upper_95)

ticks <- data.frame(hr = c(0.2, 0.5, 1, 2, 5))
ticks$x <- x_hr(ticks$hr)

axis_y <- min(factors$y) - 0.70
plot_top <- max(headings$y) + 0.55

colours <- c("Never Dibao" = "#253F67", "Ever Dibao" = "#B34E50")

# 5. Draw the forest plot -----------------------------------------------
figure1 <- ggplot() +
  geom_segment(data = ticks,
               aes(x = x, xend = x, y = axis_y + 0.1, yend = plot_top),
               colour = "#E7EAF0", linewidth = 0.25) +
  annotate("segment", x = x_hr(1), xend = x_hr(1),
           y = axis_y + 0.1, yend = plot_top,
           linetype = "dashed", colour = "#858585", linewidth = 0.55) +
  geom_segment(data = results,
               aes(x = xlow, xend = xhigh, y = y_draw, yend = y_draw,
                   colour = group), linewidth = 0.82) +
  geom_point(data = results,
             aes(x = x, y = y_draw, colour = group), size = 2.9) +
  geom_text(data = headings,
            aes(x = label_right, y = y, label = label),
            hjust = 1, family = font_family, fontface = "bold",
            size = pt_to_mm(heading_pt), colour = "#253F67") +
  geom_text(data = factors,
            aes(x = label_right, y = y, label = label),
            hjust = 1, family = font_family,
            size = pt_to_mm(body_pt), colour = "#252525") +
  annotate("segment", x = axis_left, xend = axis_right,
           y = axis_y, yend = axis_y,
           colour = "#333333", linewidth = 0.45) +
  geom_segment(data = ticks,
               aes(x = x, xend = x, y = axis_y, yend = axis_y - 0.14),
               colour = "#333333", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(data = ticks,
            aes(x = x, y = axis_y - 0.39, label = as.character(hr)),
            family = font_family, size = pt_to_mm(body_pt),
            colour = "#252525") +
  annotate("text", x = (axis_left + axis_right) / 2,
           y = axis_y - 1.10, label = "Hazard ratio (log scale)",
           family = font_family, size = pt_to_mm(body_pt),
           colour = "#252525") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = colours,
                      breaks = c("Never Dibao", "Ever Dibao"), name = NULL) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1),
                  ylim = c(axis_y - 1.70, plot_top + 0.1),
                  expand = FALSE, clip = "off") +
  labs(title = "Figure 1. Mortality Risk Factors by Dibao Status, China, 2011–2020") +
  theme_void(base_size = 12, base_family = font_family) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 13.5,
                              face = "bold", margin = margin(b = 5, unit = "pt")),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.justification = "center",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, family = font_family),
    legend.key.width = grid::unit(0.95, "cm"),
    legend.spacing.x = grid::unit(0.20, "cm"),
    plot.margin = margin(4, 3, 3, 3, unit = "mm")
  )

print(figure1)

# 6. Export at exactly 18 cm wide --------------------------------------
output_stem <- file.path(data_dir, "Figure_1_Model_A_Hukou_18cm")

if (isTRUE(capabilities("cairo"))) {
  ggsave(paste0(output_stem, ".pdf"), plot = figure1,
         device = grDevices::cairo_pdf,
         width = 18, height = 20, units = "cm", bg = "white")
} else {
  ggsave(paste0(output_stem, ".pdf"), plot = figure1,
         device = "pdf", width = 18, height = 20, units = "cm", bg = "white")
}

ggsave(paste0(output_stem, ".png"), plot = figure1,
       width = 18, height = 20, units = "cm", dpi = 300, bg = "white")

message("Figure 1 completed: 13 estimates per group (26 total).")
message("PDF: ", paste0(output_stem, ".pdf"))
message("PNG: ", paste0(output_stem, ".png"))
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Figure 2. Interaction Effects on Mortality Risk by Dibao Status, China, 2011–2020
# Updated dual-panel forest plot using:
#   A_Dibao_Interaction_Hukou.xlsx
#   - Primary_Level_HRs
#   - Primary_Block
# Size: 18 x 18 cm
# ============================================================

# If needed, install once:
# install.packages(c("readxl", "ggplot2"))

library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)

# -------------------- 1. Data folder --------------------
# Change this path only if your Excel file is stored elsewhere.
data_dir <- "/Users/apple/Desktop/Bag/rolling/Postgraduate/ADV/Week 4/data"

folders <- c(data_dir, file.path(data_dir, "A_Cox_outputs"))
folders <- folders[dir.exists(folders)]

if (length(folders) == 0) {
  stop("Data folder does not exist: ", data_dir)
}

# -------------------- 2. Find Excel file --------------------
# This function matches file names even if they contain trailing version numbers,
# such as A_Dibao_Interaction_Hukou(2).xlsx or A_Dibao_Interaction_Hukou（2）.xlsx.

find_excel <- function(stem) {

  files <- unlist(lapply(folders, function(folder) {
    list.files(
      folder,
      pattern = "\\.xlsx$",
      full.names = TRUE,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )
  }), use.names = FALSE)

  files <- unique(files[!grepl("^~\\$", basename(files))])

  if (length(files) == 0) {
    stop("No Excel files were found in the data folder.")
  }

  names_no_ext <- sub("\\.xlsx$", "", basename(files), ignore.case = TRUE)

  names_clean <- trimws(gsub(
    "[[:space:]]*[(（][^()（）]*[)）]$",
    "",
    names_no_ext
  ))

  candidates <- files[tolower(names_clean) == tolower(stem)]

  if (length(candidates) == 0) {
    stop("Excel file not found: ", stem)
  }

  plain <- candidates[
    tolower(basename(candidates)) ==
      tolower(paste0(stem, ".xlsx"))
  ]

  if (length(plain) == 1) {
    chosen <- normalizePath(plain, mustWork = TRUE)
    message("Using file: ", basename(chosen))
    return(chosen)
  }

  versions <- sub(
    ".*[(（]([0-9]+)[)）]$",
    "\\1",
    sub("\\.xlsx$", "", basename(candidates), ignore.case = TRUE),
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )

  versions <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(versions))
  versions[is.na(versions)] <- 0L

  selection <- order(
    versions,
    file.info(candidates)$mtime,
    decreasing = TRUE
  )[1]

  chosen <- normalizePath(candidates[selection], mustWork = TRUE)
  message("Using file: ", basename(chosen))
  chosen
}

input_file <- find_excel("A_Dibao_Interaction_Hukou")

# -------------------- 3. Read and validate data --------------------
all_sheets <- excel_sheets(input_file)

if (!("Primary_Level_HRs" %in% all_sheets)) {
  stop("Worksheet 'Primary_Level_HRs' is missing.")
}
if (!("Primary_Block" %in% all_sheets)) {
  stop("Worksheet 'Primary_Block' is missing.")
}

level_df <- as.data.frame(read_excel(input_file, sheet = "Primary_Level_HRs"))
block_df <- as.data.frame(read_excel(input_file, sheet = "Primary_Block"))

need_level <- c(
  "factor", "comparison",
  "Never_HR", "Never_lower_95", "Never_upper_95",
  "Ever_HR", "Ever_lower_95", "Ever_upper_95",
  "HR_ratio_Ever_vs_Never", "ratio_lower_95", "ratio_upper_95",
  "interaction_p"
)

need_block <- c(
  "analysis", "factor", "chisq", "df", "p_value", "n_interaction_terms", "status"
)

if (!all(need_level %in% names(level_df))) {
  stop(
    "Missing columns in Primary_Level_HRs: ",
    paste(setdiff(need_level, names(level_df)), collapse = ", ")
  )
}

if (!all(need_block %in% names(block_df))) {
  stop(
    "Missing columns in Primary_Block: ",
    paste(setdiff(need_block, names(block_df)), collapse = ", ")
  )
}

level_df <- level_df[, need_level, drop = FALSE]
block_df <- block_df[, need_block, drop = FALSE]

# Convert numeric columns
num_cols <- c(
  "Never_HR", "Never_lower_95", "Never_upper_95",
  "Ever_HR", "Ever_lower_95", "Ever_upper_95",
  "HR_ratio_Ever_vs_Never", "ratio_lower_95", "ratio_upper_95",
  "interaction_p"
)

for (nm in num_cols) {
  level_df[[nm]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(level_df[[nm]]))
}

block_num <- c("chisq", "df", "p_value", "n_interaction_terms")
for (nm in block_num) {
  block_df[[nm]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(block_df[[nm]]))
}

level_df$comparison <- trimws(as.character(level_df$comparison))
level_df$factor <- trimws(as.character(level_df$factor))
block_df$factor <- trimws(as.character(block_df$factor))

if (nrow(level_df) != 11) {
  stop("Primary_Level_HRs should contain exactly 11 rows.")
}

if (anyDuplicated(level_df$comparison) > 0) {
  stop("Duplicate comparison names found in Primary_Level_HRs.")
}

if (any(!is.finite(as.matrix(level_df[, num_cols])))) {
  stop("Primary_Level_HRs contains missing or invalid numeric values.")
}

if (any(level_df$Never_lower_95 <= 0 |
        level_df$Never_lower_95 > level_df$Never_HR |
        level_df$Never_HR > level_df$Never_upper_95)) {
  stop("Invalid Never HR confidence interval values.")
}

if (any(level_df$Ever_lower_95 <= 0 |
        level_df$Ever_lower_95 > level_df$Ever_HR |
        level_df$Ever_HR > level_df$Ever_upper_95)) {
  stop("Invalid Ever HR confidence interval values.")
}

if (any(level_df$ratio_lower_95 <= 0 |
        level_df$ratio_lower_95 > level_df$HR_ratio_Ever_vs_Never |
        level_df$HR_ratio_Ever_vs_Never > level_df$ratio_upper_95)) {
  stop("Invalid interaction HR ratio confidence interval values.")
}

if (any(level_df$interaction_p < 0 | level_df$interaction_p > 1)) {
  stop("Invalid interaction p-values.")
}

# -------------------- 4. Define display order and labels --------------------
layout_info <- data.frame(
  group_title = c(
    "SEX (ref: Male)",
    "INCOME (ref: T1)",
    "INCOME (ref: T1)",
    "MARITAL STATUS (ref: Partnered)",
    "MARITAL STATUS (ref: Partnered)",
    "MARITAL STATUS (ref: Partnered)",
    "LIVING CHILDREN (ref: 0)",
    "LIVING CHILDREN (ref: 0)",
    "LIVING CHILDREN (ref: 0)",
    "CHILD CORESIDENCE (ref: No)",
    "HUKOU (ref: Non-agricultural)"
  ),
  comparison = c(
    "Sex: Female vs Male",
    "Income: T2 vs T1",
    "Income: T3 vs T1",
    "Marriage: Widowed vs Partnered",
    "Marriage: Separated-Divorced vs Partnered",
    "Marriage: Never married vs Partnered",
    "Living children: 1 vs 0",
    "Living children: 2 vs 0",
    "Living children: 3+ vs 0",
    "Coresident child: Yes vs No",
    "HUKOU: Agricultural vs Non-agricultural"
  ),
  row_label = c(
    "Female",
    "T2", "T3",
    "Widowed", "Separated/Divorced", "Never married",
    "1 child", "2 children", "3+ children",
    "Yes",
    "Agricultural"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

if (!setequal(layout_info$comparison, level_df$comparison)) {
  stop("The comparisons in the Excel file do not match the expected 11 Figure 2 comparisons.")
}

# Build rows with headings + factors
rows <- data.frame(
  type = character(),
  label = character(),
  comparison = character(),
  position = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

current_pos <- 0
unique_groups <- unique(layout_info$group_title)

for (i in seq_along(unique_groups)) {
  g <- unique_groups[i]

  if (i > 1) {
    current_pos <- current_pos + 0.55
  }

  current_pos <- current_pos + 1.00

  rows <- rbind(
    rows,
    data.frame(
      type = "heading",
      label = g,
      comparison = NA_character_,
      position = current_pos,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  )

  sub <- layout_info[layout_info$group_title == g, , drop = FALSE]

  for (j in seq_len(nrow(sub))) {
    current_pos <- current_pos + 0.95

    rows <- rbind(
      rows,
      data.frame(
        type = "factor",
        label = sub$row_label[j],
        comparison = sub$comparison[j],
        position = current_pos,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    )
  }
}

rows$y <- max(rows$position) - rows$position + 1

headings <- rows[rows$type == "heading", , drop = FALSE]
factors  <- rows[rows$type == "factor",  , drop = FALSE]

# -------------------- 5. Merge plotting data --------------------
df <- merge(level_df, factors[, c("comparison", "y")], by = "comparison", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)

if (anyNA(df$y)) {
  stop("Some rows could not be aligned to the figure layout.")
}

# Build left-panel long data: Never / Ever
left_never <- data.frame(
  comparison = df$comparison,
  y = df$y + 0.16,
  group = "Never",
  hr = df$Never_HR,
  low = df$Never_lower_95,
  high = df$Never_upper_95,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

left_ever <- data.frame(
  comparison = df$comparison,
  y = df$y - 0.16,
  group = "Ever",
  hr = df$Ever_HR,
  low = df$Ever_lower_95,
  high = df$Ever_upper_95,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

left_plot <- rbind(left_never, left_ever)

# Build right-panel data: interaction HR ratio
right_plot <- data.frame(
  comparison = df$comparison,
  y = df$y,
  hr = df$HR_ratio_Ever_vs_Never,
  low = df$ratio_lower_95,
  high = df$ratio_upper_95,
  interaction_p = df$interaction_p,
  sig_group = ifelse(df$interaction_p < 0.05, "p < 0.05", "p >= 0.05"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# -------------------- 6. Axis settings --------------------
# Left panel: group-specific HRs
left_min <- 0.3
left_max <- 4.0
left_ticks <- c(0.5, 1, 2, 4)

# Right panel: interaction HR ratios
right_min <- 0.2
right_max <- 3.0
right_ticks <- c(0.2, 0.5, 1, 2)

if (any(left_plot$low < left_min | left_plot$high > left_max)) {
  stop("At least one group-specific HR CI falls outside the planned left-axis range.")
}

if (any(right_plot$low < right_min | right_plot$high > right_max)) {
  stop("At least one interaction HR ratio CI falls outside the planned right-axis range.")
}

# Overall canvas coordinates
label_x      <- 0.42
left_x0      <- 0.49
left_x1      <- 0.69
right_x0     <- 0.75
right_x1     <- 0.96

top_y        <- max(headings$y) + 1.75
axis_y       <- min(factors$y) - 0.65
plot_top_y   <- max(headings$y) + 0.15

map_left <- function(x) {
  left_x0 + (log(x) - log(left_min)) / (log(left_max) - log(left_min)) * (left_x1 - left_x0)
}

map_right <- function(x) {
  right_x0 + (log(x) - log(right_min)) / (log(right_max) - log(right_min)) * (right_x1 - right_x0)
}

left_plot$x    <- map_left(left_plot$hr)
left_plot$xlow <- map_left(left_plot$low)
left_plot$xhigh<- map_left(left_plot$high)

right_plot$x    <- map_right(right_plot$hr)
right_plot$xlow <- map_right(right_plot$low)
right_plot$xhigh<- map_right(right_plot$high)

left_tick_df <- data.frame(
  tick = left_ticks,
  x = map_left(left_ticks)
)

right_tick_df <- data.frame(
  tick = right_ticks,
  x = map_right(right_ticks)
)

# -------------------- 7. Appearance settings --------------------
font_family <- "Times New Roman"

pt_to_mm <- function(pt) {
  pt * 25.4 / 72
}

# Text sizes
title_pt       <- 13.5
panel_title_pt <- 12.5
body_pt        <- 12
heading_pt     <- 13.5
legend_pt      <- 11

# Colours
col_never  <- "#253F67"
col_ever   <- "#B34E50"
col_red    <- "#B34E50"
col_blue   <- "#253F67"
grid_col   <- "#E7EAF0"
refline_col<- "#878787"
text_col   <- "#252525"

# -------------------- 8. Manual legend coordinates --------------------
left_center  <- (left_x0 + left_x1) / 2
right_center <- (right_x0 + right_x1) / 2

# Separate panel headings from legend rows (18 x 18 cm layout).
# The original 0.32-unit gap was too small for 12.5/11-pt text.
panel_title_y <- top_y + 0.65
legend_y      <- top_y - 0.50

# Left legend positions
```

#Model B1-1/2/3/4
```{r}
# Figure 4: Model B1 Cox forest plot, four panels in ONE horizontal row
# Source: latest Model B1 Ever/Never workbooks, sheet Full_Cox_Results
# Output: 52.2 x 18 cm landscape PDF and 300 dpi PNG

# Install once, if necessary:
# install.packages(c("readxl", "ggplot2"))
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)

# 1. Files ------------------------------------------------------------
data_dir <- "/Users/apple/Desktop/Bag/rolling/Postgraduate/ADV/Week 4/data"
search_dirs <- c(data_dir, file.path(data_dir, "A_Cox_outputs"))
search_dirs <- search_dirs[dir.exists(search_dirs)]
if (length(search_dirs) == 0) stop("Data folder not found: ", data_dir)

# Accept an unversioned name or a name ending in (2), (3), etc.
find_excel <- function(stem) {
  files <- unlist(lapply(search_dirs, function(d) {
    list.files(d, pattern = "\\.xlsx$", full.names = TRUE,
               ignore.case = TRUE)
  }), use.names = FALSE)
  files <- unique(files[!grepl("^~\\$", basename(files))])
  short <- sub("\\.xlsx$", "", basename(files), ignore.case = TRUE)
  short <- trimws(gsub("[[:space:]]*[(（][0-9]+[)）]$", "", short))
  choices <- files[tolower(short) == tolower(stem)]
  if (length(choices) == 0) stop("Cannot find Excel workbook: ", stem)

  # Prefer the renamed file without a trailing (number).
  plain <- choices[tolower(basename(choices)) ==
                     tolower(paste0(stem, ".xlsx"))]
  if (length(plain) == 1) {
    chosen <- plain[1]
  } else if (length(choices) == 1) {
    chosen <- choices[1]
  } else {
    stop("Several versions found for ", stem,
         "; leave only one, or rename the intended file without its version number.")
  }
  chosen <- normalizePath(chosen, mustWork = TRUE)
  message("Reading: ", chosen)
  chosen
}

ever_file <- find_excel("Model B1_Ever_ADL_IADL_Cox_results")
never_file <- find_excel("Model B1_Never_ADL_IADL_Cox_results")

# 2. Models and exact factor names -------------------------------------
models <- c("Common_M1", "M2_ADL", "M3_IADL", "M4_ADL_IADL")
terms <- c(
  "sexFemale", "income_tertileT2", "income_tertileT3",
  "marriage_statusWidowed", "marriage_statusSeparated-Divorced",
  "marriage_statusNever married", "living_children1", "living_children2",
  "living_children3+", "living_childrenUnknown",
  "coresident_childYes", "coresident_childUnknown",
  "hukouAgricultural", "adl", "iadl"
)
expected <- list(
  Common_M1 = terms[1:13],
  M2_ADL = terms[c(1:13, 14)],
  M3_IADL = terms[c(1:13, 15)],
  M4_ADL_IADL = terms
)

# 3. Import and validate estimates ------------------------------------
read_group <- function(path, group) {
  if (!("Full_Cox_Results" %in% excel_sheets(path))) {
    stop("Missing Full_Cox_Results worksheet: ", basename(path))
  }
  # Explicit range is important: these files have an incorrect A1 sheet
  # dimension in their XML metadata, although actual data extend to I70.
  raw <- as.data.frame(read_excel(path, sheet = "Full_Cox_Results",
                                  range = "A1:I70"))
  cols <- c("Model", "term", "beta", "HR", "lower_95", "upper_95", "p_value")
  if (!all(cols %in% names(raw))) {
    stop("Missing columns in ", basename(path), ": ",
         paste(setdiff(cols, names(raw)), collapse = ", "))
  }
  d <- raw[raw$Model %in% models, cols, drop = FALSE]
  d$Model <- trimws(as.character(d$Model))
  d$term <- trimws(as.character(d$term))
  for (nm in c("beta", "HR", "lower_95", "upper_95", "p_value")) {
    d[[nm]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d[[nm]]))
  }
  if (nrow(d) != 56L || anyNA(d$term) ||
      anyDuplicated(paste(d$Model, d$term)) > 0) {
    stop(group, ": expected 56 unique Model/term estimates")
  }
  for (m in models) {
    if (!setequal(d$term[d$Model == m], expected[[m]])) {
      stop(group, ": unexpected factor names in ", m)
    }
  }
  v <- as.matrix(d[, c("beta", "HR", "lower_95", "upper_95", "p_value")])
  if (any(!is.finite(v)) || any(d$lower_95 <= 0) ||
      any(d$lower_95 > d$HR) || any(d$HR > d$upper_95) ||
      any(d$p_value < 0 | d$p_value > 1) ||
      any(abs(exp(d$beta) - d$HR) > 0.00001)) {
    stop(group, ": invalid HR, 95% CI, beta or p-value")
  }
  d$group <- group
  d
}

# 4. Factor headings and shared row positions -------------------------

  "SEX (ref: Male)", "INCOME (ref: T1)",
  "MARITAL STATUS (ref: Partnered)", "LIVING CHILDREN (ref: 0)",
  "CHILD CORESIDENCE (ref: No)",

)
factor_labels <- c(
  "Female", "T2", "T3", "Widowed", "Separated/Divorced", "Never married",
  "1 child", "2 children", "3+ children", "Unknown",
  "Yes", "Unknown", "Agricultural", "ADL", "IADL"
)

row_list <- list()
pos <- 0
for (g in seq_along(category)) {
  if (g > 1) pos <- pos + 1.10  # Extra gap between categories
  row_list[[length(row_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
    type = "heading", term = "", label = category[g], offset = pos
  )
  for (j in which(factor_group == g)) {
    pos <- pos + 1.05
    row_list[[length(row_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      type = "factor", term = terms[j], label = factor_labels[j], offset = pos
    )
  }
}
rows <- do.call(rbind, row_list)
stopifnot(identical(rows$term[rows$type == "factor"], terms))

# 5. Four panels in ONE row (52.2 x 18 cm landscape) ------------------
panels <- data.frame(
  Model = models,
  panel = c("B1", "B2", "B3", "B4"),
  subtitle = c("Original covariates", "+ ADL", "+ IADL", "+ ADL and IADL"),
  x0 = c(0.15, 13.20, 26.25, 39.30),
  top = rep(26.90, 4)
)

panel_rows <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(panels)), function(i) {
  z <- rows
  z$Model <- panels$Model[i]
  z$x0 <- panels$x0[i]
  z$y <- panels$top[i] - z$offset
  z
}))
heads <- panel_rows[panel_rows$type == "heading", ]
labels <- panel_rows[panel_rows$type == "factor", ]

# Hide ADL/IADL rows if not included, but keep their empty positions.
active <- mapply(function(model, term) term %in% expected[[model]],
                 labels$Model, labels$term)
labels <- labels[active, , drop = FALSE]

row_keys <- paste(panel_rows$Model, panel_rows$term)
result_keys <- paste(results$Model, results$term)
matched <- match(result_keys, row_keys)
if (anyNA(matched)) stop("Cox factor row alignment failed")
results$x0 <- panel_rows$x0[matched]
results$y <- panel_rows$y[matched]
results$y_draw <- results$y + ifelse(results$group == "Never Dibao", 0.20, -0.20)

# 6. Common logarithmic HR scale --------------------------------------
hr_limits <- c(0.15, 5.5)
if (any(results$lower_95 < hr_limits[1] | results$upper_95 > hr_limits[2])) {
  stop("Some confidence intervals fall outside the chosen HR limits")
}
forest_left <- 7.85
forest_right <- 12.63
map_hr <- function(hr, x0) {
  x0 + forest_left +
    (log(hr) - log(hr_limits[1])) /
    (log(hr_limits[2]) - log(hr_limits[1])) * (forest_right - forest_left)
}
results$x <- map_hr(results$HR, results$x0)
results$lo <- map_hr(results$lower_95, results$x0)
results$hi <- map_hr(results$upper_95, results$x0)

# Common axes across all panels.
ticks <- c(0.2, 0.5, 1, 2, 5)
axes <- data.frame(
  x_left = panels$x0 + forest_left,
  x_right = panels$x0 + forest_right,
  y = panels$top - max(rows$offset) - 0.65
)
tick_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(panels)), function(i) {
  data.frame(x = map_hr(ticks, panels$x0[i]), label = as.character(ticks),
             ymin = axes$y[i], ymax = panels$top[i] + 0.10)
}))
refs <- data.frame(x = map_hr(1, panels$x0),
                   ymin = axes$y, ymax = panels$top + 0.10)

# 7. Fonts, colours, shapes -------------------------------------------

  ggsave(paste0(output, ".pdf"), plot = fig4,
         device = grDevices::cairo_pdf,
         width = 52.2, height = 18, units = "cm", bg = "white")
} else {
  ggsave(paste0(output, ".pdf"), plot = fig4,
         device = "pdf", width = 52.2, height = 18, units = "cm", bg = "white")
}

ggsave(paste0(output, ".png"), plot = fig4,
       width = 52.2, height = 18, units = "cm", dpi = 300, bg = "white")

message("Done. Plotted ", nrow(results), " estimates from the two Model B1 workbooks.")
message("PDF: ", paste0(output, ".pdf"))
message("PNG: ", paste0(output, ".png"))
```

#Model B2 Interaction 
```{r}
# =====================================================================
# Figure 4. Model B2 interaction forest plot (18 x 18 cm)
# Source: Model B2_Dibao_Interaction_results.xlsx, Primary_Levels
# Left: Never and Ever adjusted HRs; right: Ever/Never HR ratios.
# HUKOU is displayed consistently with Figures 1-3:
#   Agricultural vs Non-agricultural (reference).
# IMPORTANT: This assumes source Rural = Agricultural hukou and
# Urban = Non-agricultural hukou. Verify against the raw coding.
# =====================================================================

# install.packages(c("readxl", "ggplot2"))  # Only needed once
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)

# 1. Locate the latest Excel workbook ---------------------------------
data_dir <- "/Users/apple/Desktop/Bag/rolling/Postgraduate/ADV/Week 4/data"
folders <- c(data_dir, file.path(data_dir, "A_Cox_outputs"), getwd())
folders <- unique(folders[dir.exists(folders)])

files <- unlist(lapply(folders, function(d) {
  list.files(d, pattern = "\\.xlsx$", full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
}), use.names = FALSE)
files <- unique(files[!grepl("^~\\$", basename(files))])

stem <- "Model B2_Dibao_Interaction_results"
clean_names <- sub("\\.xlsx$", "", basename(files), ignore.case = TRUE)
clean_names <- sub("[[:space:]]*[(（][0-9]+[)）]$", "", clean_names)
matches <- files[tolower(clean_names) == tolower(stem)]
if (length(matches) == 0) stop("Cannot find Model B2 interaction workbook in data_dir or current folder.")

plain <- matches[tolower(basename(matches)) == tolower(paste0(stem, ".xlsx"))]
version3 <- matches[grepl("[(（]3[)）]\\.xlsx$", basename(matches))]
if (length(plain) == 1) {
  input_file <- plain[1]
} else if (length(version3) == 1) {
  input_file <- version3[1]
} else if (length(matches) == 1) {
  input_file <- matches[1]
} else {
  stop("Multiple Excel versions found; keep one intended file or rename it without the version number.")
}
message("Reading: ", normalizePath(input_file, mustWork = TRUE))

# 2. Import exact ranges and verify original estimates ----------------
# The source workbook has incorrect worksheet dimension metadata (A1).
# Explicit ranges prevent an incomplete read.
level <- as.data.frame(read_excel(input_file, sheet = "Primary_Levels",
                                  range = "A1:AB14"))
block <- as.data.frame(read_excel(input_file, sheet = "Primary_Block",
                                  range = "A1:G9"))

required <- c("analysis", "factor", "reference_level", "level",
              "Never_HR", "Never_lower_95", "Never_upper_95",
              "Ever_HR", "Ever_lower_95", "Ever_upper_95",
              "HR_ratio_Ever_vs_Never", "ratio_lower_95", "ratio_upper_95",
              "interaction_p")
if (!all(required %in% names(level))) {
  stop("Missing fields in Primary_Levels: ",
       paste(setdiff(required, names(level)), collapse = ", "))
}
if (nrow(level) != 13 || nrow(block) != 8) {
  stop("Expected 13 Primary_Levels comparisons and 8 Primary_Block factors.")
}
if (!all(c("factor", "status") %in% names(block))) {
  stop("Missing fields in Primary_Block.")
}

for (nm in c("analysis", "factor", "reference_level", "level")) {
  level[[nm]] <- trimws(as.character(level[[nm]]))
}
block$factor <- trimws(as.character(block$factor))
if (any(level$analysis != "Primary_Substantive") ||
    !setequal(unique(level$factor), block$factor) ||
    any(as.character(block$status) != "OK")) {
  stop("Primary analysis labels, factor blocks, or model status are inconsistent.")
}

numeric_cols <- c("Never_HR", "Never_lower_95", "Never_upper_95",
                  "Ever_HR", "Ever_lower_95", "Ever_upper_95",
                  "HR_ratio_Ever_vs_Never", "ratio_lower_95", "ratio_upper_95",
                  "interaction_p")
for (nm in numeric_cols) level[[nm]] <- as.numeric(level[[nm]])
if (any(!is.finite(as.matrix(level[, numeric_cols]))) ||
    any(level$interaction_p < 0 | level$interaction_p > 1)) {
  stop("Invalid numeric results or interaction p-values.")
}
for (group in c("Never", "Ever")) {
  hr <- level[[paste0(group, "_HR")]]
  lo <- level[[paste0(group, "_lower_95")]]
  hi <- level[[paste0(group, "_upper_95")]]
  if (any(lo <= 0 | lo > hr | hr > hi)) {
    stop("Invalid ", group, " confidence interval.")
  }
}
if (any(level$ratio_lower_95 <= 0 |
        level$ratio_lower_95 > level$HR_ratio_Ever_vs_Never |
        level$HR_ratio_Ever_vs_Never > level$ratio_upper_95)) {
  stop("Invalid interaction ratio confidence intervals.")
}
if (any(abs(level$Ever_HR / level$Never_HR -
            level$HR_ratio_Ever_vs_Never) > 1e-6)) {
  stop("Interaction ratios do not equal Ever HR divided by Never HR.")
}

# 3. Match all 13 comparisons to the intended order -------------------
# Keys refer to the ORIGINAL Excel (before recoding Hukou).
layout <- data.frame(
  factor = c("sex", "income_tertile", "income_tertile",
             "marriage_status", "marriage_status", "marriage_status",
             "living_children", "living_children", "living_children",
             "coresident_child", "hukou", "adl", "iadl"),
  reference_level = c("Male", "T1", "T1", "Partnered", "Partnered",
                      "Partnered", "0", "0", "0", "No", "Rural",
                      "Per 1 point", "Per 1 point"),
  level = c("Female", "T2", "T3", "Widowed", "Separated-Divorced",
            "Never married", "1", "2", "3+", "Yes", "Urban",
            "Per 1 point", "Per 1 point"),
  label = c("Female", "T2", "T3", "Widowed", "Separated/Divorced",
            "Never married", "1 child", "2 children", "3+ children",
            "Yes", "Agricultural", "Per 1-point increase",
            "Per 1-point increase"),
  section = c(1, 2, 2, 3, 3, 3, 4, 4, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
make_key <- function(d) paste(d$factor, d$reference_level, d$level, sep = "|")
if (anyDuplicated(make_key(level)) ||
    !setequal(make_key(level), make_key(layout))) {
  stop("Excel factor/reference/level combinations differ from the expected 13 rows.")
}
level <- level[match(make_key(layout), make_key(level)), , drop = FALSE]

# 4. REVERSE the Hukou contrast (not merely its displayed label) ------
# Excel: Urban vs Rural. Plot: Agricultural vs Non-agricultural.
# Valid only if Urban=Non-agricultural and Rural=Agricultural hukou.
h <- which(level$factor == "hukou")
if (length(h) != 1 || level$reference_level[h] != "Rural" ||
    level$level[h] != "Urban") {
  stop("Unexpected Hukou coding; reference reversal has been cancelled.")
}

for (group in c("Never", "Ever")) {
  hr_col <- paste0(group, "_HR")
  lo_col <- paste0(group, "_lower_95")
  hi_col <- paste0(group, "_upper_95")
  old_lo <- level[[lo_col]][h]
  old_hi <- level[[hi_col]][h]
  level[[hr_col]][h] <- 1 / level[[hr_col]][h]
  level[[lo_col]][h] <- 1 / old_hi
  level[[hi_col]][h] <- 1 / old_lo
}
old_ratio_lo <- level$ratio_lower_95[h]
old_ratio_hi <- level$ratio_upper_95[h]
level$HR_ratio_Ever_vs_Never[h] <- 1 / level$HR_ratio_Ever_vs_Never[h]
level$ratio_lower_95[h] <- 1 / old_ratio_hi
level$ratio_upper_95[h] <- 1 / old_ratio_lo
level$reference_level[h] <- "Non-agricultural"
level$level[h] <- "Agricultural"
# interaction_p remains unchanged when the reference category is reversed.

# Recheck the transformed ratio and confidence intervals.
if (any(abs(level$Ever_HR / level$Never_HR -
            level$HR_ratio_Ever_vs_Never) > 1e-6) ||
    level$ratio_lower_95[h] > level$HR_ratio_Ever_vs_Never[h] ||
    level$HR_ratio_Ever_vs_Never[h] > level$ratio_upper_95[h]) {
  stop("The recoded Hukou estimates failed consistency checks.")
}
message(sprintf(
  "HUKOU Agricultural vs Non-agricultural: Never %.3f; Ever %.3f; ratio %.3f; p %.3f",
  level$Never_HR[h], level$Ever_HR[h],
  level$HR_ratio_Ever_vs_Never[h], level$interaction_p[h]
))

# 5. Category headings and row positions -----------------------------
headings <- c("SEX (ref: Male)", "INCOME (ref: T1)",
              "MARITAL STATUS (ref: Partnered)",
              "LIVING CHILDREN (ref: 0)",
              "CHILD CORESIDENCE (ref: No)",
              "HUKOU (ref: Non-agricultural)", "ADL", "IADL")
row_y <- numeric(13)
heading_y <- numeric(8)
y <- 14.65
for (s in 1:8) {
  heading_y[s] <- y
  y <- y - 0.54
  for (i in which(layout$section == s)) {
    row_y[i] <- y
    y <- y - 0.48
  }
  y <- y - 0.15
}
heading_df <- data.frame(x = 7.43, y = heading_y, label = headings)
label_df <- data.frame(x = 7.43, y = row_y, label = layout$label)

# 6. Two logarithmic axes --------------------------------------------
left_limits <- c(0.25, 4.5)
right_limits <- c(0.14, 3.0)
left_bounds <- c(7.85, 12.10)
right_bounds <- c(13.15, 17.72)
map_log <- function(value, limits, bounds) {
  bounds[1] + (log(value) - log(limits[1])) /
    (log(limits[2]) - log(limits[1])) * (bounds[2] - bounds[1])
}
if (any(c(level$Never_lower_95, level$Ever_lower_95) < left_limits[1]) ||
    any(c(level$Never_upper_95, level$Ever_upper_95) > left_limits[2]) ||
    any(level$ratio_lower_95 < right_limits[1]) ||
    any(level$ratio_upper_95 > right_limits[2])) {
  stop("An HR confidence interval lies outside a plotting scale.")
}

never <- data.frame(y = row_y + 0.11, type = "Never",
                    hr = level$Never_HR, lo = level$Never_lower_95,
                    hi = level$Never_upper_95, factor = level$factor)
ever <- data.frame(y = row_y - 0.11, type = "Ever",
                   hr = level$Ever_HR, lo = level$Ever_lower_95,
                   hi = level$Ever_upper_95, factor = level$factor)
left <- rbind(never, ever)
left$x <- map_log(left$hr, left_limits, left_bounds)
left$xlo <- map_log(left$lo, left_limits, left_bounds)
left$xhi <- map_log(left$hi, left_limits, left_bounds)

right <- data.frame(y = row_y,
                    type = ifelse(level$interaction_p < 0.05,
                                  "p < 0.05", "p >= 0.05"),
                    hr = level$HR_ratio_Ever_vs_Never,
                    lo = level$ratio_lower_95,
                    hi = level$ratio_upper_95,
                    factor = level$factor)
right$x <- map_log(right$hr, right_limits, right_bounds)
right$xlo <- map_log(right$lo, right_limits, right_bounds)
right$xhi <- map_log(right$hi, right_limits, right_bounds)
plot_data <- rbind(left, right)

left_ticks <- c(0.5, 1, 2, 4)
right_ticks <- c(0.2, 0.5, 1, 2)
ticks <- data.frame(
  x = c(map_log(left_ticks, left_limits, left_bounds),
        map_log(right_ticks, right_limits, right_bounds)),
  label = as.character(c(left_ticks, right_ticks))
)

# 7. Plot appearance --------------------------------------------------
font <- "Times New Roman"
pt_mm <- function(pt) pt * 25.4 / 72
navy <- "#253F67"
red <- "#B34E50"
colors <- c("Never" = navy, "Ever" = red,
            "p >= 0.05" = navy, "p < 0.05" = red)

legend_items <- data.frame(
  x = c(8.40, 10.46, 13.53, 15.84),
  y = rep(15.55, 4),
  type = c("Never", "Ever", "p >= 0.05", "p < 0.05"),
  label = c("Never", "Ever", "p >= 0.05", "p < 0.05")
)

fig4 <- ggplot() +
  # Gray HR=1 reference lines
  annotate("segment", x = map_log(1, left_limits, left_bounds),
           xend = map_log(1, left_limits, left_bounds),
           y = 2.73, yend = 14.50, linetype = "dashed",
           linewidth = 0.55, colour = "#888888") +
  annotate("segment", x = map_log(1, right_limits, right_bounds),
           xend = map_log(1, right_limits, right_bounds),
           y = 2.73, yend = 14.50, linetype = "dashed",
           linewidth = 0.55, colour = "#888888") +
  # HR points and 95% confidence intervals
  geom_segment(data = plot_data,
               aes(x = xlo, xend = xhi, y = y, yend = y, colour = type),
               linewidth = 0.72) +
  geom_segment(data = plot_data,
               aes(x = xlo, xend = xlo, y = y - 0.04,
                   yend = y + 0.04, colour = type), linewidth = 0.42) +
  geom_segment(data = plot_data,
               aes(x = xhi, xend = xhi, y = y - 0.04,
                   yend = y + 0.04, colour = type), linewidth = 0.42) +
  geom_point(data = subset(plot_data, !factor %in% c("adl", "iadl")),
             aes(x = x, y = y, colour = type), size = 2.5) +
  geom_point(data = subset(plot_data, factor %in% c("adl", "iadl")),
             aes(x = x, y = y, colour = type), size = 1.6) +
  # Headings and labels: shared by both panels
  geom_text(data = heading_df, aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
            family = font, fontface = "bold", hjust = 1,
            size = pt_mm(12.2), colour = navy) +
  geom_text(data = label_df, aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
            family = font, hjust = 1, size = pt_mm(11.5),
            colour = "#252525") +
  # Panel titles are above the legends (no overlap)
  annotate("text", x = mean(left_bounds), y = 16.26,
           label = "Group-specific HRs", family = font,
           size = pt_mm(12), fontface = "bold") +
  annotate("text", x = mean(right_bounds), y = 16.26,
           label = "Interaction HR ratio", family = font,
           size = pt_mm(12), fontface = "bold") +
  # Two separate legends
  geom_segment(data = legend_items,
               aes(x = x - 0.22, xend = x + 0.08,
                   y = y, yend = y, colour = type), linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(data = legend_items,
             aes(x = x - 0.07, y = y, colour = type), size = 2.2) +
  geom_text(data = legend_items,
            aes(x = x + 0.18, y = y, label = label),
            family = font, size = pt_mm(10), hjust = 0) +
  # Horizontal axes, tick marks and labels
  annotate("segment", x = left_bounds[1], xend = left_bounds[2],
           y = 2.69, yend = 2.69, colour = "#333333", linewidth = 0.45) +
  annotate("segment", x = right_bounds[1], xend = right_bounds[2],
           y = 2.69, yend = 2.69, colour = "#333333", linewidth = 0.45) +
  geom_segment(data = ticks,
               aes(x = x, xend = x, y = 2.69, yend = 2.56),
               linewidth = 0.40, colour = "#333333") +
  geom_text(data = ticks, aes(x = x, y = 2.25, label = label),
            family = font, size = pt_mm(11)) +
  annotate("text", x = mean(left_bounds), y = 1.70,
           label = "Hazard ratio (log scale)",
           family = font, size = pt_mm(11)) +
  annotate("text", x = mean(right_bounds), y = 1.70,
           label = "HR ratio (log scale)",
           family = font, size = pt_mm(11)) +
  # Figure title, separated from panel titles and legends
  annotate("text", x = 9, y = 17.38,
           label = "Figure 4. Interaction Effects on Mortality Risk by Dibao Status,\nChina, 2011–2020 (Model B2)",
           family = font, fontface = "bold", lineheight = 1.05,
           size = pt_mm(12.0), hjust = 0.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = colors, guide = "none") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 18), ylim = c(0.95, 18.0),
                  expand = FALSE, clip = "off") +
  theme_void(base_family = font, base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(3, 3, 3, 3, unit = "mm"))

# 8. Export -----------------------------------------------------------
print(fig4)
out <- file.path(dirname(input_file), "Figure_4_Model_B2_Hukou_Reference_Corrected_18cm")
if (isTRUE(capabilities("cairo"))) {
  ggsave(paste0(out, ".pdf"), plot = fig4,
         device = grDevices::cairo_pdf,
         width = 18, height = 18, units = "cm", bg = "white")
} else {
  ggsave(paste0(out, ".pdf"), plot = fig4, device = "pdf",
         width = 18, height = 18, units = "cm", bg = "white")
}
ggsave(paste0(out, ".png"), plot = fig4, width = 18, height = 18,
       units = "cm", dpi = 300, bg = "white")
message("Figure 4 completed: 13 comparisons and 8 factor sections.")
message("PDF: ", paste0(out, ".pdf"))
message("PNG: ", paste0(out, ".png"))
```
